seasonRead.headline: 2018–19: There is no single recipe for a useful forward
paragraphs: Perimeter Skill Scorer and High-Volume Playmaking Scorer put skill first, but in different ways: one scores from space, the other mixes shot threat with distribution and recovery.

The next layer is just as revealing. Checking-Line Disruptor and Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist form a substantial support tier, separating disruption and defensive detail from primary creation. That is a lineup economy with specialized jobs, not one prototype repeated four times.

seasonRead.headline: 2018–19: Puck movement leads a three-part blue line
paragraphs: Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman carries the most complete play-driving signature: distribution, team chance share and the willingness to accept some puck risk in exchange for moving the attack forward.

Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman and Defensive Role Defenseman divide much of the remaining work between blocks and lower-event responsibility. The practical challenge is to keep enough puck advancement on every pair that one bad shift does not become two.
